read.thesis: Teva's 2025 guide is revenue +2–5% and FCF down to $1.6–1.9B, with API held for sale and Revlimid cliff planned; supply discipline is mostly absent as R&D rises above 6% of revenue.

triggers.label: FCF guide cut to $1.6–1.9B
triggers.quote: We expect our 2024 free cash flow to be in the range of $1.6 billion to $1.9 billion. This represented a slight decrease compared to 2024

triggers.label: API business classified held for sale
triggers.quote: on December 31st, we classified the API business as a held for sale

triggers.label: AUSTEDO US revenue up 34%
triggers.quote: It's a 34% growth and we got strong TRx growth of 34% also.

triggers.label: Revlimid erosion planned as cliff
triggers.quote: we planned for it being a cliff. So we haven't anticipated any soft landing.

guidance.quote: we expect 2025 revenue of $16.8 billion to $17.4 billion.
This brings us the expected non-GAAP earnings per share in the range of $2.35 to $2.65.
We expect our 2024 free cash flow to be in the range of $1.6 billion to $1.9 billion.
We expect gross margin in 2025 to be stable and consistent with 2024 level, approximately in the range of 53% to 54%.
our outlook of $1.9 billion to just over $2 billion for 2025
